description: SCOPe benchmark for biologically meaningful structural classification, evolutionary inference, domain interpretation, dataset design, and supporting API evidence.

conditions.description: Pretrained model only; no skill, API, fixtures, or MCP tools.
Pretrained model with captured access to the live SCOPe REST API; no skill or MCP tools.
Pretrained model with captured access to the same live SCOPe REST API plus the public scop-homology skill; no MCP tools.
Pretrained model with the SCOPe MCP server (stdio) as its only route to SCOPe data; the server's REST traffic is captured; no shell, skill, or direct REST access.
Pretrained model with the SCOPe MCP server (stdio) plus the public scop-homology skill read from the workspace; no shell or direct REST access.

tracks.conformance: API-literacy controls reported separately from biological performance.
tracks.held_out: Biological cases whose named entities and answer-bearing identifiers are absent from the public skill and references.

biological.description: Primary benchmark questions reported on separate biological-reasoning and factual-support axes; the secondary gated score prevents unsupported claims from being hidden by strong prose.

api_conformance.description: Release and identifier literacy reported separately from the primary biological benchmark.
